Record Class VanishBridgeMessage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.plex.network.VanishBridgeMessage
Record Components:
action - requested action or reported state
playerId - player UUID
silent - whether the action must not send a join or leave message
public record VanishBridgeMessage(VanishBridgeMessage.Action action, UUID playerId, boolean silent) extends Record
A vanish message sent between Plex servers and proxies.
